_note: Grade anchors recorded under audit_mode from 2 isolated, identical runs per key by tools/test_architecture/simq_reanchor.py (never typed by hand). Policy: docs/plans/test_architecture/reference/baseline_change_policy.md; the record of each re-anchor (SHA, run ids, owner ruling, before/after table) is under agent-working/stored_artifacts/. See docs/simulation_quality/quality_scoring_contract.md §11.3.
_instructions: Each pillar entry is an object {grade, score} (score = normalized_score from quality_report.json, not raw_score). Two independent checks run against it: (1) letter-grade band ±1 — if a pillar grade moves by more than one letter from the anchor, the regression test fails (anchor=B accepts A/B/C, fails D or S); (2) score tolerance — the live normalized_score must stay within max(0.05, 0.20 * |anchored_score|) of the anchored score, independent of whether the letter grade moved (catches within-band magnitude regressions the letter check alone cannot see). Either check failing is a regression. To update: do NOT edit this file by hand. Measure every key under audit_mode in 2 isolated processes (calibrate_simq --audit-mode), run python -m tools.test_architecture.simq_reanchor to write the new file and the before/after table, get the content owner's written ruling on the moved rows, and commit them with the provenance file (see the policy above).
